Effect on Other Documents

IRM 21.5.1, Account Resolution-General Adjustments, dated August 25, 2025 (effective October 1, 2025) is superseded. This revision incorporates the following IRM Procedural Updates (IPUs): IPU 25U3702 (issued 12-08-2025), IPU 26U0391 (issued 04-02-2026), IPU 26U0662 (issued 06-23-2026).

Audience

All IRS organizations - Small Business/Self Employed (SB/SE), Large Business & International (LB&I), Tax Exempt and Government Entities (TE/GE) and Taxpayer Services (TS), IRS Independent Office of Appeals, Employee Plans (all employees performing account work).
